r15.selection: metadata only matching exact day and fine/high resolution name, up to 12 unique Proxima and 8 calibrator products; known frequency targeted replay not blind. companion predictions use published 2.000004 MHz spacing; not exact published centroids

r16.selection: L band first six scans, first lexicographic common backend high resolution product whose metadata covers 1400 MHz; retain all 6 scan files, ON1/OFF1/ON2/OFF2/ON3/OFF3. Fixed window exploratory search only.

r17.task: Binary experimental classification of deterministic synthetic narrowband injections versus unmodified real OFF patches; background not known signal-free. Separate catalog of real OFF / reverse-cadence evidence, no extraterrestrial labels. Four R9 training targets separate from four R11 test targets. Tiny transformer, fixed seed, no test-based tuning, compare robust track-statistic baseline; no production change.

claim_ceiling: Development/archive reanalysis only; no extraterrestrial origin, independent confirmation, or automatic weight adoption.
